title: On Creating a new pattern from the old
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：create　|　正文 363 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 create 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the builder ① created a new pattern from the old with great care, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② creates a new pattern from the old on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ create a new pattern from the old at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ created a new pattern from the old before — a line in the plan for October 1960 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Creating a new pattern from the old with great care, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ create no end of trouble for us on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Create no end of trouble for us at once and never mention it again.

By 1973 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ creates no end of trouble for us with great care every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ created a new pattern from the old again when nobody else would.

⑩ To create a new pattern from the old, my mother said in 1978, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody creates a new pattern from the old on the same day again and somebody must create a new pattern from the old with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 创造（一般过去式 created a new pattern from the old：1966 年施工员头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 创造（一般现在 creates a new pattern from the old：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 创造（不定式 to create a new pattern from the old：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 创造（过去完成时 had created a new pattern from the old：1960 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 创造（动名词 creating a new pattern from the old 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 造成（create no end of trouble for us：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去造成给我们添了没完的麻烦）
G. v. 造成（create no end of trouble for us：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 创造（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 creates no end of trouble for us，而母亲又一次 created a new pattern from the old）

answers.why: create 意为“创造”，1966 年施工员小心翼翼地创造在旧花样上创出新花样，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 created。
create 意为“创造”，自那以后施工员当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 creates。
create 意为“创造”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯创造在旧花样上创出新花样”，此处为不定式 to create a new pattern from the old。
create 意为“创造”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1973 年之前就有人创造过，故用过去完成时 had created。
create 意为“创造”，施工员说“创造在旧花样上创出新花样这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 creating a new pattern from the old 作主语。
create 意为“造成”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去造成给我们添了没完的麻烦”，should ever 之后用原形 create no end of trouble for us。
create 意为“造成”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻造成给我们添了没完的麻烦（create no end of trouble for us at once），以后再也不要提起。
create 意为“创造”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例造成给我们添了没完的麻烦，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 creates。
create 意为“创造”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地创造在旧花样上创出新花样，用一般过去式 created 叙述。
create 意为“创造”，结尾那句是母亲 1978 年的话：要创造在旧花样上创出新花样，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 create 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the builder created a new pattern from the old with great care, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder creates a new pattern from the old on the same day whenever the site asks.
Creating a new pattern from the old with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever create no end of trouble for us on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site creates no end of trouble for us with great care every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother created a new pattern from the old again, and the site remembered that half.
